## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Implementation notes

- What changed?
- Are there security, privacy, permissions, signing, or data-storage implications?
- Are any features still partial or dependent on external configuration?

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit tests pass.
- [ ] Android debug build succeeds.
- [ ] Changes were reviewed for regressions and unintended file changes.
- [ ] Documentation reflects actual behavior.
- [ ] No API keys, OAuth tokens, signing files, user data, or private source were added.

## Evidence

Link the relevant CI run or explain why a check could not be run.

## Compatibility / migration

Describe changes to database schemas, app versioning, signing, stored preferences, OAuth scopes, or user setup when applicable.
